title: Rahab: an exploded planet that became the asteroid belt

tellings.quote: So, so the idea is that the the the asteroid field that the asteroid belt between uh Mars and Jupiter that that is the residue of a planet that exploded.

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino says the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter is "the residue of a planet that exploded," a planet he links to the name Rahab. He summarises the idea without his own evidence, crediting an author named David Flynn and works called Cydonia and Birthright, along with the biblical Psalms. If true, it would mean an ancient cosmic catastrophe is remembered in scripture.
